title: AI agent body enrolment (ADR-046)
description: How a machine becomes the body of an AI agent, and how it signs every request after. Worked examples, with signatures, are in identity-agent-core/agentbody/body-vectors.json.

enrolment_string.description: Handed to the machine out of band: the text iabody1. followed by the base64url (no padding) of an enrolment object. A reader refuses any other prefix, any version but 1, and an enrolment missing url, ia, d, agent or secret.

enrolment.description: The fields of an enrolment string. The machine accepts the Identity Agent's key log only if it is ia's and holds the event sn/d, so whoever wrote the string decided which Identity Agent the machine will believe.

url.description: where the Identity Agent is reached

sn.description: sequence number of an event in the Identity Agent's key log

agent.description: the AI agent the machine will become the body of

name.description: the AI agent's name, for the person at the machine

secret.description: single use; lets the machine ask, grants nothing

exp.description: when the string stops working, 15 minutes after it is made

keys.description: The body's public keys. host is its identifier, derived from its signing key: 1AAI + compressed P-256 point for a key in secure hardware, B + Ed25519 key for a software key. verkey is the same key in verification form (1AAJ or D). The four sealing keys are base64url; keys_digest = Blake3-256 (CESR code E) over the lines IA-BODY-KEYS-V1, host, verkey, x25519, mlkem768, ed25519, mldsa65 joined with a newline.

enrol_proof.description: The string the body's key signs to ask to be enrolled: the lines IA-BODY-ENROL-V1, ia, agent, secret, a fresh nonce, host, verkey, keys_digest, the claimed grade, platform (e.g. macos/arm64) and placement (computer, vm, cloud or device), joined with a newline, no trailing newline.

six_words.description: Shown on both screens so a person can compare them: Blake3-256 of IA-BODY-WORDS-V1, a newline, then host. Words 1-5 are the first 55 bits in 11-bit groups, word 6 the next 11 bits, each an index into the BIP-39 English list.

signed_request.description: Every request a body makes is signed over the lines IA-BODY-REQ-V3, the Identity Agent's identifier (X-IA-Body-For), host (X-IA-Body-Host), the method upper-cased, the request target exactly as sent (escaped path and query), X-IA-Body-Timestamp, X-IA-Body-Nonce, Blake3-256 (CESR) of the body bytes, X-Work-Item, X-Reason and X-IA-Session, joined with a newline; an absent header is an empty line. The signature travels in X-IA-Body-Sig. The timestamp must be within 2 minutes of the Identity Agent's clock, and a signature is accepted once.

X-IA-Body-Sig.description: 0B + Ed25519 signature, or 0I + P-256 r||s in low-s form; a high-s P-256 signature is refused

grade.description: How strongly the body's key is held, weakest first. A claim above hardware-asserted is recorded as hardware-asserted until its evidence can be checked; any other claim is recorded as software.
